description: Catching a bad plan before the agent acts on it, not after.

title: Decomposition
description: Break a goal into steps that can be executed and verified independently — separating a goal from a task from a step, giving every step a completion condition you can actually check, telling real dependency apart from steps that only look independent, and replanning cleanly when one step fails instead of restarting from scratch.

title: Choosing an Approach
description: Make an agent pick a sensible strategy rather than the first one it thought of — generating real alternatives, running cheap checks before expensive work, knowing when to cut losses on an approach that isn't working, and leaving behind a record of why it chose what it chose.
